scenarios.name: full_read
scenarios.description: Every slice in soft, lung and bone windows (one pass each), full field, 150 ms per slice.

scenarios.name: window_skip_lung
scenarios.description: Full stack in soft and bone windows only; the lung window is never used.

scenarios.name: window_skip_bone
scenarios.description: Full stack in soft and lung windows only; the bone window is never used.

scenarios.name: region_skip_left_lung
scenarios.description: Lung-window pass shows only the patient's right side of the gap between the lungs (panned square view ending at the split column c=254); soft and bone passes are full field.

scenarios.name: dwell_skip_lung
scenarios.description: Lung-window pass flicks through the stack at ~15 ms per slice (below the minimum dwell); soft and bone passes are normal.

scenarios.name: slice_skip_caudal
scenarios.description: The caudal 60 of 133 slices (k 0..59, 45%) are never displayed; all other slices are read in soft, lung and bone windows.

scenarios.name: partial_lung
scenarios.description: Lung window only over the cranial 52 of 105 lung slices (50%); soft and bone passes cover the full stack.

scenarios.name: organ_skip_spleen
scenarios.description: On the 23 slices containing Spleen, the soft-window pass shows only panned square views around its bounding box covering the image minus the organ dilated by 3 px; lung and bone passes are full field.

scenarios.name: organ_skip_kidney_left
scenarios.description: On the 26 slices containing Left kidney, the soft-window pass shows only panned square views around its bounding box covering the image minus the organ dilated by 3 px; lung and bone passes are full field.
